summary: Cursor's Hobby plan is a genuinely free tier of the AI code editor: no credit card required, with limited Agent requests and access to the Composer model. Pro tiers only extend limits, so everyday autocomplete and agent use stay free.
claim_steps: Go to cursor.com/pricing and pick the Hobby (Free) plan.
Download and install the Cursor editor.
Sign in with a free account - no credit card needed.
Use Agent within the limited free quota; upgrade only if you need more.
